title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
Flam is the AI-native content platform taking the internet beyond video. We generate life-like immersive visuals and fluid interactions — streamed applessly in under 300ms — powering advertising, commerce, and communication for Fortune 500 brands. Our proprietary model family (Fable, Fantom, Falcon) sits at the intersection of generative AI, real-time rendering, and enterprise GTM. We're early, fast-moving, and defining a new content format category from scratch.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a passionate and motivated Software Engineering Intern to join our engineering team. You’ll work closely with experienced developers to design, build, and test features that impact real users. This is a hands-on internship where you’ll gain exposure to the full software development lifecycle—from ideation to deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the engineering team to design, develop, and test software solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
* Debug and troubleshoot application issues across different environments.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in software development.
* Assist in integrating APIs, improving performance, and maintaining existing systems.
* Design and develop interactive 3D experiences using Three.js, WebGL, and theCanvas API.
* Research emerging technologies and propose innovative solutions.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend teams to translate product requirements into technical solutions.

**What We're Looking For**

* Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented design.
* Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, or Go).
* Familiarity with web development frameworks, databases, or cloud technologies is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Architect, develop, and maintain scalable and modular frontends using React and Next.js.
* Build reusable components and libraries using modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React,Next.Js).
* Eagerness to learn and contribute in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Nice To Have

* Prior internship or project experience in software development.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience with React, Vue.js,Next.js or another frontend framework.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Exposure to Git/GitHub, APIs, or DevOps tools.
* Understanding of Agile development processes.

title: UX Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
The Elastic IT team is shifting beyond standard chat interfaces to craft the next frontier of generative and agentic AI experiences. We are looking for an innovative UX & Front End Engineer to join our team to bridge the gap between powerful AI capabilities and intuitive, delightful user interfaces that accelerate productivity across the entire organization.
  
  
Our ideal candidate is a skilled front-end engineer with hands-on experience designing and building AI user experiences (e.g., streaming text, dynamic prompt workflows, agent reasoning visualizations, and multi-modal interaction patterns). In this role, you will leverage the latest AI technologies and the Elastic Stack (including ESRE, Agent Builder, Workflows and eUI) to build high-performance front-end applications for a suite of internal products and platforms. Driven by a user-centered mindset, you will act as a key collaborator between AI back-end engineers, product managers, and user groups to turn complex AI reasoning into seamless human-AI interactions. By shaping how enterprise users interact with generative AI, you will enable our global workforce while showcasing the boundary-pushing capabilities of Elastic's products.
  
  
Are you ready to design and build the interfaces that supercharge enterprise productivity and prove what’s possible with Elastic? Join us to create AI user experiences that turn collective knowledge into instant action, empowering everyone at Elastic to achieve more.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* AI UI/UX Design & Implementation: Translate complex generative and agentic AI processes into intuitive, responsive, and engaging front-end interfaces.
* Front-End Architecture: Design, build, and maintain front-end UI component libraries. These libraries should be scalable, accessible, and reusable and will be created for generative AI interactions. You will use modern frameworks like React and TypeScript.
* Human-AI Interaction Patterns: Prototype and implement novel interaction patterns for conversational AI, agent execution visibility (thought logs, tool calls), prompt systems, and rich dynamic outputs.
* Performance & Streaming Optimization: Optimize UI performance for real-time AI responses, managing token streaming latency, async state management, and optimistic UI updates.
* Enterprise Grounding & Integration: Connect front-end interfaces to internal services. This includes Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) endpoints. It also includes Elasticsearch Relevance Engine (ESRE) and agent orchestration APIs.
* User-Centered Collaboration: Partner closely with UX designers, product managers, and AI backend engineers to iteratively test and refine AI workflows based on real user feedback.
* Accessibility & Design Systems: Ensure all front-end interfaces strictly adhere to web accessibility standards (WCAG) and align seamlessly with Elastic's core design system (EUI).
* AI Observability & UX Analytics: Implement front-end tracking to monitor user satisfaction, prompt effectiveness, interaction latency, and interface usability.
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for UI component systems, front-end architecture, and design pattern guidelines.

**What You Bring:**

* Proven Success in AI UX: Recent experience creating user interfaces for GenAI applications is important. This includes working with conversational interfaces, dynamic prompt builders, and complex agent workflows.
* Front-End Mastery: Deep expertise in modern TypeScript, JavaScript, React, HTML5, and CSS/Sass, with an emphasis on modular architecture.
* State Management & Streaming: Deep experience managing complex asynchronous UI state, WebSockets, and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for streaming LLM responses.
* UX/UI Design Foundations: Proficient background or active practice in user experience design, wireframing, design systems, and rapid prototyping.
* An Appetite to Master Elastic: A solid desire to learn and leverage the Elasticsearch Relevance Engine (ESRE), Elastic UI (EUI), and the broader Elastic ecosystem.
* AI Framework & API Integration: Experience with integrating front-end systems with AI/LLM backend services and orchestration tools (e.g., LangGraph, REST/GraphQL APIs).
* Design System Integration: Experience extending and contributing to enterprise design systems and component documentation tools like Storybook.
* Web Performance & Accessibility: Knowledge of web performance optimization techniques, cross-browser compatibility, and WCAG accessibility guidelines.
* Design Tooling: Hands-on experience with modern design and handoff tools (e.g., Figma).

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

**Security & Privacy Responsibilities:**
Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.
  
  
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
  
  
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate\_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
  
  
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws and can view the following posters linked below:
  
  
Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster
  
  
Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Welcome to Natus Sensory India**
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**Summary**
Natus Sensory is seeking a Salesforce Engineer to own the end-to-end architecture, design, and technical governance of our Salesforce platform. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ, along with integration touchpoints across our broader enterprise systems, including our ERP platform.
  
  
This is not a design-only role: he is also expected to personally implement enhancements and serve as the top-tier escalation point when issues arise, rolling up their sleeves to resolve urgent production, integration, and CPQ problems directly. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on architecture experience across the full Salesforce platform lifecycle -- from data model and security design through integration architecture, hands-on build, and release governance -- and can operate independently as the primary technical authority for Salesforce within the organization. This person will partner closely with the business-side Salesforce admin team, the broader IT organization, and the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared systems.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Salesforce Platform Architecture & Strategy (25%)**

* Own the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, including org structure, data model, sharing/security model, and platform scalability roadmap
* Translate business requirements from Sales, Service, and Operations stakeholders into scalable, well-governed technical designs
* Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices across Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative automation (Flow)
* Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and AppExchange products; recommend adoption where it advances the roadmap
* Lead architectural review of major enhancements, custom development, and third-party package implementations
* Maintain a multi-year Salesforce technical roadmap aligned with business strategy

**Integration Architecture (20%)**

* Design and govern integration architecture between Salesforce and enterprise systems, including ERP (Oracle EBS or similar), Microsoft 365, and other business systems
* Architect and oversee middleware/integration platform usage (MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS) for real-time and batch integrations
* Define API strategy, data synchronization patterns, and error-handling/monitoring standards across integrations
* Partner with ERP, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure integration reliability and data integrity across systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-system integration issues

**Enhancement Implementation & Hands-On Development (15%)**

* Personally build and deploy approved enhancements -- including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow automation, and configuration -- rather than handing designs off exclusively to others
* Own delivery of enhancement projects end-to-end: requirements, build, testing, and release, balancing scope, quality, and timeline
* Partner with the business-side Salesforce admin team to convert approved designs into working, tested solutions in the org
* Write and maintain clean, well-documented, testable code and configuration that other admins/developers can support

**CPQ & Quote-to-Cash Architecture (10%)**

* Architect and maintain Salesforce CPQ configuration, including product catalog, pricing rules, approval workflows, and quote templates
* Design quote-to-cash process flows in partnership with Sales Operations and Finance
* Ensure CPQ architecture scales with evolving product lines, pricing models, and channel strategies
* Troubleshoot CPQ configuration issues and guide the business admin team on best practices

**Data Architecture, Security & Governance (15%)**

* Design and maintain the Salesforce data model, including object relationships, record types, and data lifecycle management
* Define and enforce security architecture: profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security
* Establish data governance standards, including deduplication, data quality rules, and archiving/retention policies
* Support compliance and audit activities related to Salesforce access, data handling, and change management
* Administer and govern DevOps/release management tooling (e.g., Salesforce DX, Gearset, Copado, or similar) and sandbox strategy

**Production Support & Escalations (10%)**

* Serve as the top-tier escalation point for complex Salesforce, integration, and CPQ issues that the business admin team cannot resolve
* Roll up sleeves to directly troubleshoot and resolve urgent, business-impacting production issues rather than deferring to others
* Triage and drive resolution of production incidents, coordinating with IT and business stakeholders as needed
* Maintain and improve runbooks and troubleshooting documentation based on recurring escalations
* Be responsive and available for critical, time-sensitive support needs outside of standard change requests

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management (5%)**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all Salesforce architecture decisions
* Liaise with the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared Salesforce systems, integrations, and escalated issues
* Mentor administrators and junior developers on platform best practices
* Communicate technical roadmaps, trade-offs, and risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership

*Travel Required: Minimal; occasional travel for planning sessions or team meetings may be requested.*
**Qualification Requirements**

* Willingness to personally build and deploy enhancements, not just design and hand off to others
* 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including 3+ years in an architect-level role
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud
* Hands-on experience architecting and supporting Salesforce CPQ (product catalog, pricing, approvals, quote-to-cash)
* Proven experience designing and governing integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (ERP, middleware/iPaaS such as MuleSoft)
* Strong command of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce declarative tools (Flow)
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps/release management practices and tools (Salesforce DX, version control, CI/CD pipelines)
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, scalable technical architecture
* Comfortable serving as a top-tier escalation point for urgent, complex issues and rolling up sleeves to resolve them directly
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Self-starter mentality: able to independently own architecture decisions and production issues with minimal oversight
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or actively pursuing the CTA credential
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect and/or System Architect
* Additional certifications: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Platform Developer II
* Experience in a medical device, life sciences, or other regulated industry environment
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA as they relate to CRM data
* Experience integrating Salesforce with Oracle EBS or comparable ERP platforms
* Experience with Health Cloud or other industry-specific Salesforce clouds

**Education And/or Experience**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Salesforce architect-level certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal education.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to own and shape Salesforce architecture for a growing medical device organization
* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, with benefits package
* Exposure to enterprise integration architecture (Salesforce, ERP, MuleSoft/iPaaS) in a regulated industry.

**Compensation and Benefits:**
Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
**Join Natus Sensory today.**

**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**

description:
**About Leena AI**
Leena AI is a leader in
**Agentic AI**
for the enterprise. We are building an iconic company, delivering
**AI Colleagues**
that transform back-office functions and accelerate the full promise of Generative AI - unlocking real productivity gains, cutting costs, and delighting employees at scale.

Leena AI integrates with 1000+ applications, including SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft Office 365. We are proud to be trusted by 500+ global enterprises and 20 million+ employees, including leading brands such as
**Nestlé, Puma, Coca-Cola, Sony, and Etihad Airways.**
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, Leena AI has secured over $40M in financing from top-tier investors including Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This role owns leena.ai website end-to-end: shipping website changes, standing up A/B testing, and driving conversion optimization. It also owns the initial PLG surface: improving the sandbox experience and building a lightweight product wedge that gives prospects self-serve value before a sales conversation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Website Changes & Page Development
* Own the leena.ai codebase (Next.js / React deployed on Cloudflare); ship new pages, redesigns, and campaign landing pages within days, not sprints.
* Implement responsive, accessible, and performant front-end code aligned with the Design team's specs.
* Build reusable page templates and component libraries so Marketing can compose pages with minimal engineering lift.
* Manage deployment pipelines, staging environments, and site reliability (uptime, Core Web Vitals, page speed).
* A/B Testing Infrastructure
* Evaluate and implement an A/B testing infrastructure that can be integrated with the existing analytics stack.
* Build the plumbing: experiment assignment, event tracking, statistical significance reporting, and audience segmentation.
* Create a self-serve experimentation workflow so Marketing and Growth can launch, monitor, and conclude tests without engineering tickets.
* Document experimentation standards (sample size, run time, success metrics) for the team.
* Conversion-Rate Optimization
* Instrument the full visitor funnel — landing → page scroll → CTA click → demo form submit → confirmation with event-level tracking (GA4, Segment, or equivalent).
* Analyze conversion data by page, traffic source, geography, and device to identify drop-off points.
* Run iterative experiments on headlines, hero sections, social proof, form fields, and CTA placement to improve demo-request conversion rate.
* Partner with the Marketing teams to close the loop from website lead to qualified pipeline, feeding learnings back into page design.
* Sandbox & Product Wedge
* Own the Leena sandbox experience reduce setup friction, improve time-to-value.
* Build and iterate on a product wedge: a self-serve tool on leena.ai (e.g., HR ticket analyzer, automation ROI calculator) that uses Leena's domain model to deliver value a general-purpose LLM can't replicate.
* Instrument the wedge funnel; signups, activation, engagement, PQL conversion.
* Work with Product to define what "product-qualified" means and how wedge usage maps to enterprise buying intent.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of professional front-end or full-stack web development experience.
* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization).

title: Senior Technical Architect Frontend eCommerce
description:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect, Frontend for large scale, high traffic eCommerce platforms. This is a client facing, hands on architecture role responsible for defining enterprise UI standards, driving composable and headless commerce solutions, and mentoring frontend engineering teams across multiple programs. The candidate is expected to be framework agnostic, with deep hands on expertise across more than one modern UI framework or library, and the ability to make objective technology choices based on business and platform context.
  
  
The work splits two ways. Sometimes you'll join a program that has lost momentum and work out why. Other times you'll start from nothing, design the architecture yourself, and walk senior client stakeholders through it. Either way, you're expected to have built the thing you're talking about.

title: Senior Engineer (frontend)
description:
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Sage, you will contribute and lead in the design, development, and delivery of features for a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. You will work closely with product managers and designers and proactively share your own knowledge of frontend technologies and practices with the wider team. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.
  
  
We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of professional experience in software development for scalable, web-based applications.
* Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.

Core languages & frameworks
  
  

* Strong TypeScript (strict) and modern JavaScript (ES Modules, async).
* Deep React experience (hooks, composition, performance); React 19 / React Compiler a plus.
* Solid HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/accessible UI fundamentals.

Build & tooling
  
  

* Modern build tooling Vite (or Webpack/Rollup); code splitting and bundle optimization.
* Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus.
* Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline.

State & data
  
  

* State management with Redux Toolkit, XState (state machines), and/or TanStack Query.
* RxJS / reactive streams.
* Consuming REST APIs; JWT/OAuth2 bearer auth on the client; robust error handling.

Styling & design systems
  
  

* Tailwind CSS, MUI (Material UI), styled-components/Emotion.
* Working with a design-token system for brand consistency.

Data grids & performance
  
  

* Complex data grids (ag-Grid Enterprise preferred, or TanStack Table/Handsontable): virtualization, server-side row model, custom renderers/editors.
* Frontend performance profiling and optimization (rendering, memoization, main-thread work).
* Web Workers for off-main-thread compute.

Accessibility & i18n
  
  

* WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility practices; ARIA, keyboard, focus management.
* Internationalization (i18next or similar), including locale-aware date/number formatting.

Testing & quality
  
  

* Unit/component testing (Vitest/Jest + Testing Library), API mocking (MSW), and Playwright E2E.
* Secure client-side coding against the OWASP Top 10 (XSS, token handling, safe storage).

AI Tooling
  
  

* Productive use of AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate day-to-day frontend development.
* Building AI-assisted / generative-AI UX: in-app copilots, natural-language querying, or smart suggestions surfaced to the user.
* Integrating LLM APIs on the client (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) with streaming/token-by-token rendering, cancellation, and graceful error/loading states.

Soft skills
  
  

* Strong problem-solving abilities and an eagerness to learn.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Web Crypto / AES-GCM application-level encryption and client-side key management.
* Lexical (or ProseMirror/Slate) rich-text/formula editors; grammar parsing (ohm-js).
* Dependency-graph / DAG modeling (graphlib/graphology).
* CRDT / operational-transform real-time collaboration.
* Storybook and visual regression testing.
* New Relic browser RUM, Pendo, and web-vitals (INP/FPS) instrumentation.
* Experience meeting enforced performance budgets and SLOs in CI.
* Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, budgeting, or spreadsheet-like applications.
* Designing accessible, trustworthy AI interaction patterns, such as citations, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review for sensitive outputs.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain new features for our SaaS platform, applying a broad knowledge of frontend principles and practices to difficult assignments.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, and act as a source of technical guidance in code reviews and best-practice discussions.
* Mentor and coach junior members of the development team.
* Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified in the production environment.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and security of the platform.
* Implement and maintain automated tests to ensure software reliability.
* Work closely with the design team to ensure the platform is user-friendly and follows UI/UX best practices.
* Partner effectively with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver assigned work.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in web development and cloud-based SaaS technologies.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
About the Role

At Independence OS, we're building AI-native infrastructure to fundamentally transform how healthcare operates.

We're not simply adding AI to existing healthcare software. We're reimagining healthcare workflows from first principles, building intelligent systems that make healthcare operations faster, simpler, and more efficient.

We're looking for a 
**Frontend Engineering Lead**
 who can architect, build, and scale the next generation of healthcare applications across web and mobile.

You'll work on products powering US primary care, including AI-powered medical documentation, intelligent front-desk agents, patient management, clinical workflows, revenue cycle management, and value-based care.

This is a 
**hands-on engineering leadership role with end-to-end ownership**
. You'll define frontend architecture, build high-performance applications, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and take products from concept to production.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, AI engineers, and clinical stakeholders to build intuitive, reliable, and scalable healthcare experiences.

What You'll Do

* **Own Frontend Architecture:**
   Design and maintain scalable, high-performance frontend architectures across React web applications and React Native mobile applications.
* **Build AI-Native Healthcare Experiences:**
   Develop intuitive interfaces for AI-powered medical scribes, conversational agents, clinical documentation, patient scheduling, billing, and healthcare operations.
* **Lead Web and Mobile Development:**
   Architect, develop, deploy, and continuously improve production-grade applications across web, iOS, and Android.
* **Engineer for Performance:**
   Optimize rendering, application responsiveness, data fetching, caching, bundle sizes, and Core Web Vitals to ensure seamless experiences in demanding clinical environments.
* **Build Scalable Design Systems:**
   Establish reusable component libraries, shared application logic, frontend standards, and consistent user experiences across products.
* **Integrate Real-Time AI Systems:**
   Build responsive interfaces for streaming AI outputs, real-time patient information, conversational experiences, and complex clinical workflows.
* **Own End-to-End Product Delivery:**
   Take responsibility for frontend system design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* **Lead Engineering Excellence:**
   Conduct code reviews, mentor frontend engineers, establish best practices, improve development workflows, and help grow the engineering team.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:**
   Work closely with product, design, AI, backend, and clinical teams to translate complex healthcare requirements into simple, reliable user experiences.
* **Build Secure Healthcare Applications:**
   Implement secure authentication, permission-aware interfaces, and appropriate handling of protected health information (PHI), aligned with HIPAA requirements.

What We're Looking For

* 6+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, with deep expertise in React, React Native, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
* Proven experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade web and mobile applications.
* Strong understanding of frontend system architecture, reusable component libraries, state management, and scalable application design.
* Hands-on experience with React Native development for iOS and Android, including application deployment, navigation, native integrations, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization, rendering, caching, asynchronous data fetching, and application responsiveness.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, authentication systems, and complex backend services into frontend applications.
* Experience with frontend testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and maintaining high-quality production code.
* Proven ability to lead frontend engineering initiatives, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and establish technical standards.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently architect and own complex technical solutions.
* A product-oriented engineering mindset, with a willingness to take ownership beyond writing code.

Good to Have

* Experience building real-time applications involving WebSockets, streaming APIs, conversational AI, or voice-based interfaces.
* Familiarity with healthcare technology, EHR/EMR integrations, FHIR/HL7, HIPAA, or US healthcare operations.
* Experience with React Native ecosystems, including Expo, React Navigation, native modules, and over-the-air updates.
* Experience with frontend testing tools such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Detox, or Maestro.
* Familiarity with monorepo architectures, shared component libraries, Nx, Turborepo, and design systems.
* Experience with native iOS or Android development using Swift or Kotlin.
* Understanding of accessibility standards and building inclusive, user-friendly applications.
* Experience working in early-stage startups and building products from the ground up.

Why Independence OS?

You'll work on healthcare technology designed to operate in real clinical environments, not just prototypes or isolated demonstrations.

Our products integrate with real healthcare workflows, and the interfaces you build will directly influence how physicians, clinical teams, and healthcare operators interact with AI-powered systems.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* **Build from the ground up:**
   Shape the architecture and user experience of AI-native healthcare products.
* **Own meaningful systems:**
   Take responsibility for frontend applications from initial design through production deployment.
* **Solve complex real-world problems:**
   Build software used in demanding healthcare environments where speed, reliability, and usability matter.
* **Work across AI and healthcare:**
   Collaborate directly with engineers and clinical stakeholders building the next generation of healthcare infrastructure.
* **Lead with ownership:**
   Influence engineering decisions, mentor developers, and help shape the frontend engineering culture.

**We're looking for engineers who don't just build interfaces, but take ownership of how entire products are experienced, engineered, and scaled.**

title: Frontend Development Internship
description:
**About Nubra**

Nubra is a SEBI-registered trading platform built for active traders and investors. Our users watch live market data, place orders, and manage risk in real time, which makes the frontend the product itself, not a wrapper around it. Every number on screen has to be correct, and every interaction has to feel instant.

**About the Internship**

We're looking for Frontend Engineering Interns to join our Web team or our Mobile App team, based on your strengths and interests. This is not a shadowing internship. You'll work on real features that ship to real users, with mentorship from experienced engineers throughout. You don't need to know our exact stack yet. We care more about strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, and how quickly you learn.

Interns who perform well during the 6 months will be offered a full-time role at Nubra.

**Internship Details**

- Location: Bangalore (Onsite)

- Duration: 6 months, with a full-time conversion opportunity based on performance

- Start Date: Immediately

- Stipend: ₹50,000 - 60,000 per month

**What You'll Do**

- Build and ship features on our web platform or mobile apps, such as watchlists, order screens, positions, the option chain, and charts

- Learn to work with live market data over WebSockets and build screens that stay smooth as prices update rapidly

- Turn Figma designs into clean, responsive UI using our shared component library and design system

- Write well-structured code and handle loading, error, and empty states properly

- Debug issues, write tests, and learn how to find and fix slow screens

- Work with Design, Backend, and Product to understand what you're building and why

- Take part in code reviews and learn from detailed feedback

**What We're Looking For**

- Pursuing a B.Tech / B.E. / Dual Degree in Computer Science or a related field.

- Strong fundamentals in JavaScript (or TypeScript), HTML, and CSS

- Hands-on experience with at least one frontend or mobile framework through projects, hackathons, or prior internships. Any of React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin works

- Understanding of how a UI talks to a backend: APIs, async calls, and handling responses and errors

- Good grasp of data structures, algorithms, and writing clean, readable code

- Comfort with Git

- Curiosity, ownership, and the ability to pick up new tools quickly

- Availability for the full 6-month duration, onsite in Bangalore

**Nice to Have**

- Projects, open-source contributions, or live apps you can show (GitHub or portfolio link)

- Exposure to TypeScript, React, or React Native

- Interest in stock markets, trading, or fintech

- Experience with charts or data visualization (Chart.js, D3, Highcharts, etc.)

- Familiarity with real-time features like WebSockets or live updates

- Exposure to testing tools (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright)

**What You'll Get**

- Real ownership of features used by traders every day

- Mentorship from experienced engineers and regular feedback

- Exposure to how a trading platform works end to end, from market data to order execution

- A full-time role, based on your performance during the internship

title: Senior R&D Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
R&D Team Lead
  
  
  
  
  
  
**What We Believe In**
ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
  
  
We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.
  
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Contribute significantly to successful project results in technology and/or product development by identifying, proposing and implementing innovative solutions. Use unique technical knowledge to oversee development tasks. Working closely with Product Owner and Scrum Master, understand business requirements and help translate these into technical requirements.
  
  
Individual contributor using in-depth knowledge in a specific area to execute complex or specialized projects / challenges often thinking independently to challenge traditional solutions. Comprehensive knowledge of related disciplines in the organization. Works independently, applying established standards and instructs or coaches other professionals
  
  
The work model for the role is: Hybrid
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Deliver end-to-end product development including design, reviews, consulting, and hands-on development, while providing technical leadership across local and remote teams. Collaborate with Product Owners to identify new opportunities and manage installations, configurations, troubleshooting, upgrades, technical training, and documentation.
* Provide consulting support to business operations and customers within area of expertise, and represent the team in internal and external engineering forums to ensure effective collaboration and visibility.
* Drive innovation while maintaining oversight of intellectual property within the domain, develop IP strategies, and proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across R&D projects and organizational processes.
* Apply strong competencies in safety, quality, innovation, ownership, and collaboration while leveraging R&D expertise in technical domains, tools, processes, communication, and risk and IP management to deliver high-quality outcomes.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering with 8–10 years of experience designing and developing enterprise-level web applications, with advanced expertise in ReactJS and strong backend development using .NET Framework, .NET Core, and C#.
* Proven ability to design and develop modern, scalable, and responsive web applications, with ownership of front-end architecture and UI design while contributing across the full stack.
* Strong experience handling complex engineering assignments requiring advanced problem-solving skills and the application of innovative technical solutions.
* Hands-on expertise in ReactJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks, along with proven experience delivering at least one end-to-end application as a Full-Stack Developer.
* Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices, with strong troubleshooting capabilities across module, product, and system levels, and hands-on experience with Azure cloud services.
* Exposure to software architecture and design tools such as UML, C4 model, ArchiMate, Enterprise Architect, Visio, Draw.io, and Lucidchart for application and system design.
* Demonstrated understanding of AI and emerging technologies, along with the ability to act as a subject matter expert by mentoring team members, sharing knowledge, and contributing to continuous learning within the team.

**More About Us**
This role is part of the R&D Lab and focuses on ensuring cybersecurity excellence in industrial product development. You will play a key role in safeguarding next-generation industrial systems by embedding security into the core of product innovation.
  
  
You will contribute to building secure, compliant, and resilient solutions that align with organizational values of safety, integrity, and operational excellence.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Warning
  
  
ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
  
  
View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home
  
  
For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Lead engineer (.Net,React,AWS)
description:
**Job Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical lead responsibility to support and mentor the development team.
  
  
Contribute towards the Architecture, Design and technical debt of the product.
  
  
Analyze Requirements & Design Solutions: Interpret business and customer requirements, participate in technical discussions, and design scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
  
  
Backend Development: Develop RESTful Web APIs and backend services using C# and .NET technologies.
  
  
Frontend Development: Build responsive and user-friendly interfaces using React, JavaScript, and HTML5.
  
  
Database & Integration: Design and implement data models, integrate with databases and third-party services, and ensure optimal performance.
  
  
Unit Testing & Quality Assurance: Develop and execute unit tests using xUnit/MS Test and follow TDD/BDD practices where applicable.
  
  
Code Review & Best Practices: Review code within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring compliance with coding standards, performance guidelines, and business constraints.

* 8+ years of experience in full stack design and development.
* Experience working in multi-site or global teams.
* Strong proficiency in: C# / .NET technologies, Web API development, React, JavaScript, HTML5
* Experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, Lambda, S3, etc.).

* Knowledge of BDD, TDD, MS Test, xUnit.

* Good planning and organizational skills
* Collaborative approach to sharing ideas and finding solutions
* Ability to work independently and also in a global team environment.

8+ years of experience in full stack design and development.

title: Specialist - Software Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
Location- Bellandur bangalore
  
  
Shift timings: 01:30 - 10:30 PM
  
  
Experience- 12- 16years
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Mentoring**
**Architecture & Solution Design**
**Software Engineering & Full-Stack Development**
**Cloud & Azure Development Engineering**
**Frontend Engineering & User Experience**
**Agile Delivery & Collaboration**
**Generative AI & Modern Engineering Practices**
**Enterprise Tools & Standards**
**Primary skill- Backend Development,Frontend Development,Cloud Engineering,Database & Integration,Engineering Practices,Architecture & Leadership**
**Required Skills / Qualifications**

* 10 – 15 years of professional software engineering experience, with deep, expert-level hands-on expertise in C#, .NET Core / .NET, ASP.NET Web API, and full-stack application development.
* Strong working knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS/SCSS for frontend development.
* Experience building cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure PaaS services.
* Hands-on experience with REST API development, backend services, system integration, and SQL-based data access.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, dependency injection, object-oriented programming, asynchronous programming, debugging, source control, and testing.
* Experience using Git and Azure DevOps pipelines for source control, CI/CD, and release automation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and ownership skills.
* Proven experience owning end-to-end solution and integration architecture for enterprise-grade, cloud-hosted applications.
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and drive engineering standards and best practices across a team.
* Experience leading design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision-making for complex, cross-system initiatives.
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders, communicate technical trade-offs, and influence architecture and delivery decisions.

**Secondary / Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Azure Service Bus, Azure Redis, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, and Azure SQL Database.
* Exposure to Docker, containerization concepts, and Azure Container Registry.
* Experience with Azure Monitoring, logging, application insights, and production observability practices.
* Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including Azure Active Directory integration.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar enterprise-approved AI-assisted development tools.
* Awareness of secure coding, application scanning, DAST, dependency management, and enterprise compliance practices.
* Relevant RMF, reservoir engineering, forecasting, or subsurface domain knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.

**Behaviours & Continuous Improvement**

* Demonstrates Way and Operational Excellence behaviours: direct, decisive, accountable, and results-focused.
* Takes ownership of assigned work items and drives them to closure with quality and accountability.
* Shows initiative in identifying technical improvements, automation opportunities, and modernization ideas aligned with RMF product objectives.
* Collaborates effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Demonstrates openness to feedback, continuous learning, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Contributes to a safe, respectful, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.
* Leads by example, elevates the technical bar of the team, and mentors others toward growth and engineering excellence.

**Role Success Indicators**

* Delivers secure, scalable, and maintainable full-stack application features aligned to business priorities.
* Builds reliable .NET APIs, Angular interfaces, and Azure-hosted services that improve user experience and operational stability.
* Improves engineering quality through testability, observability, reusable components, and disciplined delivery practices.
* Supports predictable Agile delivery through ownership, collaboration, proactive risk identification, and continuous improvement.
* Establishes sound, scalable architecture and integration designs that stand up over time and reduce technical debt.
* Grows team capability through mentoring, code reviews, and adoption of consistent engineering standards.
* Acts as a trusted technical advisor to product owners and leadership on solution direction, risks, and modernization opportunities.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Who are we?
  
  
Founded in 2014 by Khadim Batti and Vara Kumar, Whatfix is a leading global B2B SaaS provider and the largest pure-play enterprise digital adoption platform (DAP). Whatfix empowers companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments across the application lifecycle, from ideation to training to the deployment of software. Driving user productivity, ensuring process compliance, and improving user experience of internal and customer-facing applications.
  
  
Spearheading the category with serial innovation and unmatched customer-centricity, Whatfix is the only DAP innovating beyond the category, positioning itself as a comprehensive suite for GenAI-powered digital adoption, analytics, and application simulation. Whatfix product suite consists of 3 products - DAP, Product Analytics, and Mirror. This product suite helps businesses accelerate ROI on digital investments by streamlining application deployment across its lifecycle.
  
  
Whatfix has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.
  
  
Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including over 80 Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Microsoft, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
  
  
Investors: Raised a total of ~$270 million. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million led by Warburg Pincus with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer Investments, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.
  
  

* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Recognized as a “Leader” in the digital adoption platforms (DAP) category for the past 4+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* The only vendor recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2024 Gartner® Voice of the Customer for Digital Adoption Platforms has once again earned the Customers’ Choice distinction in 2025. We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a high CSAT of 99.8%
* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fourth Consecutive Year
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal
* On the G2 peer review platform, Whatfix has received 77 Leader badges across all market segments, including Small, Medium, and Enterprise, in 2024, among numerous other industry recognitions.

Solutions Engineer
  
  
Solutions Engineer is a highly strategic, high-exposure role that will drive the use of Whatfix, being a trusted consultant to our customers by guiding them during the product's implementation, and internally evangelizing on the diverse use cases of Whatfix implementation. You will drive the onboarding, product solution-ing, end-to-end implementation of the product, to deliver a seamless user experience.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Develop, test, and maintain robust code for various features, ensuring functionality across different environments and platforms.
* Design scalable and maintainable software architectures that support the Product's growth and evolution, considering future feature additions and integrations.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues within the Application, applying problem-solving skills to devise and implement effective solutions.
* Work with our customers to configure, test & integrate Whatfix solutions into enterprise applications
* Acquire and Leverage your knowledge across various Enterprise Applications to define the framework for Whatfix Implementation
* Pilot new feature releases to directly influence the overall Product development roadmap
* Work cross-functionally in collaboration with different departments, including Product, Customer Success, Sales, Customer Support, and Marketing

What are we looking for?
  
  

* BTech CSE, BTech IT / ITES, MTech, BCA, or MCA with No Backlogs.
* Excellent Problem solving skills.
* Full-Time work experience - At least 3 years of Work experience in Web Technology (HTML, JS, CSS), APIs and Databases
* Experience on other Languages and Frameworks will be an added advantage.
* Good Knowledge on Software Architecture and Design Patterns.
* Impeccable verbal and written communication skills (Very Important)
* Ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders while dealing with complex situations.

**Note:**

* At Whatfix, we thrive on the power of collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We strongly believe that working together in our office (five days a week) fosters open communication, builds a sense of community, and fuels innovation. This ensures open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and enables us to achieve our collective goals effectively.
* At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month.
* In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.
* We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust is the foundation; and Do it as you own it.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.

This role will be backend heavy and frontend working knowledge is a plus.
  
  
Primary responsibility -
  
  

* Implementation of technical solutions based on business requirements.
* Estimation of effort and impact of the items you work on.
* Show high quality of craft/work in what you deliver.
* Understanding the quality of automated tests is equally important as production code

and spending time refactoring both, when needed, to ensure ease of change enabling a

implement technical tasks.

infrastructure automation, frameworks, tooling or services.
  
  

* Partner with Senior Engineers and your peers to build new capabilities & reuse existing

capabilities as much as possible.
  
  

* Own the design and delivery of software solutions based on business requirements,

deploying and monitoring code in production with some supervision
  
  
**Role Qualifications And Requirements**

* A minimum of 3 years of experience in full stack web application development.
* Proven expertise with one or more server-side programming languages, including (Ex.

area

* Has sufficient knowledge to describe the implications of changing an existing system or

* Has sufficient knowledge to help grow the business and/or accelerate software

development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor
  
  
evaluation) and standards
  
  

* Has sufficient knowledge to meet business needs by designing solutions that meet

current requirements and are adaptable for future enhancements
  
  
Critical Thinking
  
  

* Is responsible to systematically identify patterns and underlying issues in complex

situations, and to find solutions by applying logical and analytical thinking.
  
  

* Is responsible to constructively evaluate and develop ideas, plans and solutions by

reviewing them, objectively taking into account external knowledge, initiating 'SMART'
  
  
improvements and articulating their rationale.
  
  
Continuous Quality and Process Improvement
  
  

* Has sufficient knowledge to identify opportunities for process, system and structural

improvements (i.e performance gains) by examining and evaluating current process
  
  
flows, methods and standards.
  
  

* Has sufficient knowledge to design and implement relevant improvements by defining

adapted/new process flows, standards, and practices that enable business

Effective Communication
  
  

* Is responsible to deliver clear, well-structured, and meaningful information to a target

audience by using suitable communication mediums and language tailored to the
  
  
audience
  
  

* Is responsible to achieve mutually agreeable solutions by staying adaptable,

title: SDE2 - Customer Experience (L2)
description:
**About Zinier**
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  
At Zinier, our Support Engineers leverage a strong foundation in JavaScript development, API integrations, and MySQL or any SQL based DBMS. Expertise in React would be an added bonus. We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to bring advanced technical depth and independent ownership to our Customer Experience function.
  
  
In this role, you will handle complex technical escalations, mentor junior engineers, and act as a strategic liaison between Support, Product, and Engineering. This opportunity is ideal for senior developers who excel in high-impact environments, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and want to shape our customer experience standards—with clear career progression pathways into senior technical or customer-centric roles, such as Senior Software Development Engineer, Solution Developer, Solution Architect and Delivery. For those who are interested in Customer Success, that could be a career path as well. Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries. Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself.

title: Lead React Native Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Responsibilities: - Offline-first architecture - complete the WatermelonDB transition. Design the sync strategy, conflict resolution logic, and local schema that supports the full member data model. Make the app feel instant on 2G in a Tier-3 city. - Wearable abstraction layer - design a unified internal API that the RN layer uses to consume health data regardless of source. Own the Terra integration. Build and own direct native module integrations as new wearables come into scope. - Native module ownership - HealthKit, wearable SDKs, background sync, push notification handling. You are comfortable in Swift and Kotlin enough to build and debug native modules when the JS bridge is insufficient. - Performance and reliability - app startup time, background task management, battery impact of sync operations, crash rate. These metrics are yours to own. - Technical direction for a team of three - one SDE-2 and two SDE-1s. You set the code quality bar, run reviews, make the architectural calls, and grow the engineers under you. - Roadmap input - as we expand the app to serve doctors and nutritionists on mobile in future, you will be in the room where those product decisions are made. Your technical judgment shapes what is possible. - The stack: React Native, WatermelonDB, MMKV, Terra API, Apple HealthKit, WHOOP SDK, Oura API, Swift / Kotlin (native modules), FastAPI backend, Supabase / PostgreSQL, GCP - The app is cross-platform iOS and Android. iOS is primary - most of our members are on iOS, and the wearable ecosystem is richer there. Android parity is important and maintained. Requirements: - You have shipped a production React Native app that real people use daily, dealt with the offline scenarios, the background sync edge cases, the iOS version fragmentation, and the native module debugging that no Stack Overflow answer covers. You have scar tissue. - You think about mobile architecture the way a backend engineer thinks about distributed systems - with respect for failure modes, eventual consistency, and the consequences of getting sync wrong on someone's health data. - You are comfortable owning a problem completely. Not "I implemented the feature. You designed it, built it, debugged it in production, monitored it, and iterated on it when it was not good enough. - 6-8 years of mobile engineering, with meaningful React Native production experience. - Offline-first experience - WatermelonDB, Realm, or equivalent. You understand sync conflict strategies and have implemented at least one in production. - Native module experience - Swift or Kotlin, ideally both. You have bridged a native SDK to RN and debugged it across OS versions. - Wearable or health data integration - Apple HealthKit, Google Fit, or direct device SDK experience. Understanding of background fetch, workout sessions, and sensor data reliability. - Strong TypeScript discipline. The codebase you maintain will be read by engineers less experienced than you. Types are documentation. - Enough backend literacy to understand a sync protocol, read a PostgreSQL schema, and debug a data inconsistency without needing a backend engineer to hold your hand. Green flags: - You have dealt with Terra, HealthKit aggregation, or multi-source health data normalisation and know exactly where the sharp edges are. - You have a strong opinion about the right WatermelonDB schema design for a health data model and can defend it. - You have worked at a startup where you were the only or primary mobile engineer and made decisions with no safety net. - You have personal interest in longevity, wearables, or quantified self. You use the kind of products you would be building. - You have thought about what offline-first means for health data specifically - where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it is not. title: Senior Software Engineer in AI - FrontEnd React/Redux, Java
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
  
  
Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer in AI - Front End React/Redux, Java**
Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. The cloud contact center market has become the hot space for innovation in real-time communications, and is the tip of the spear for the application of Artificial Intelligence. Five9 has led the charge with its Genius AI platform. Five9 offers a high-energy environment with lots of room for personal and professional growth. Our innovative AI team is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Voice of Customer (VOC) team. AI experience is required for this role - you will work hands-on with AI technologies from vendors like Azure, OpenAI, Google, Databricks, IBM, and Amazon, and continue to build on some of the hottest skills on the market. An ideal candidate for us is an experienced engineer who is passionate about building high performance web platforms and applications, a brilliant problem solver and a creative self-starter.
  
  
Voice of Customer (VOC) is Five9’s AI-powered customer insights product. Every day, contact centers handle enormous volumes of voice and chat conversations that hold the clearest signal about what customers actually want - and almost none of it gets read. VOC applies AI to those conversations at scale to surface why customers are reaching out, how those reasons cluster and shift over time, and where the business should act. The result is a set of insights and analytics that CX and operations leaders use to make decisions, with the ability to trace any insight back to the conversations behind it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement UX designs by working with UX Designers on a day-to-day basis, using React/Redux based framework
* Build the customer-facing insights experience for VOC - interactive dashboards, charts, and drill-down views over AI-generated insights
* Be part of an agile team to develop a scalable, highly available application platform using modern PaaS platforms such as GCP
* Participate and contribute to requirements analysis and grooming
* Understand how to leverage PaaS components, such as CDN, noSQL databases when developing software in order to achieve scalability, reliability, and operability
* Ability to build custom widgets for dashboards developed using Google Looker Studio plugins is a plus, but not required
* Document and communicate clearly architecture and implementation solutions
* Have ownership of your code in production, including on-call, troubleshooting

**Key Skills:**

* 5+ years software development experience (mandatory)
* React/Redux focus
* Highly proficient in JavaScript and Java
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered product interfaces - presenting model output to users and supporting human review and correction of it
* Experience building data-heavy or analytics interfaces - charts, dashboards, filtering, and large result sets
* Experience with PaaS hosted relational and no-SQL databases
* Desirable, but not required, experience with custom widget development using Google Looker Studio
* Experience in operational code ownership - on-call, troubleshooting, uptime
* Experience in applying modern UI design patterns and separating concerns in a distributed system
* Familiarity with vibe coding using different AI tools like Claude Code
* Must have experience working within an Agile/Scrum team
* Positive, self-motivated and enthusiastic attitude with a strong sense of ownership
* Strong pro-active communication skills, both verbal and written
* AI skills in speech recognition and natural language processing are a plus but not required
* Experience in contact center software is a plus but not required

This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.
  
  
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

title: Staff/ Sr. Staff Engineer
description:
Shape the future of work in complex industries.
  
  
At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control.
  
  
Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy-asset industries.
  
  
We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff Full stack Engineer with strong frontend expertise to help shape, scale, and continuously evolve the KogniTwin platform. In this role, you will take ownership of application architecture across the stack, drive frontend excellence, and influence engineering standards across multiple teams and products.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and evolve application architecture across frontend and backend systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Design and build modern, data-rich web applications to visualise and interact with complex industrial data.
* Take end-to-end ownership of critical features across the stack from discovery to release and observability.
* Drive frontend architecture, component design, performance optimisation, and technical quality across teams.
* Contribute to backend services, APIs, and data integration layers where needed. - Establish and promote best practices in design systems, code quality, testing, and CI/CD.
* Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and Platform teams to align on architecture and delivery.
* Mentor engineers and guide teams in adopting scalable patterns and modern engineering practices.

**What You’ll Bring (Must-Have)**

* 10+ years of experience in software development with strong expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript.
* Deep hands-on expertise with a modern frontend framework (Angular preferred).
* Proven experience defining and scaling frontend architecture for complex, enterprise-grade applications.
* Strong experience with Node.js and backend service development (APIs, microservices).
* Solid understanding of API design, frontend-backend integration, and state management.
* Strong experience in Object-Oriented Design, system design, and service-oriented architecture.
* Hands-on experience with testing frameworks, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and drive engineering standards across teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with MEAN stack (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Angular).
* Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, or distributed systems.
* Experience with design systems, accessibility, and frontend performance optimisation.
* Experience with 3D visualization libraries (e.g., WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js).
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS).
* Experience architecting or developing mobile applications (e.g., Flutter or similar frameworks).
* Exposure to data platforms, analytics systems, or GenAI/LLM-based applications

**Why join Falkor?**
You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.
  
  
**At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To**

* Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
* Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
* Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
* Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.
  
  
**About Falkor**
Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle.
  
  
By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Apply today with your resume.

* Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining end-to-end enterprise web applications using .NET technologies and modern front-end frameworks
* Translating business and functional requirements into scalable application architecture, technical designs, APIs, data models, and user experiences
* Building backend services and RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core
* Developing responsive and reusable user interfaces using Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI component libraries
* Designing and optimizing relational database objects, queries, and data-access components using SQL Server or equivalent databases

* Hands-on experience with at least one modern front-end framework, preferably Angular or React, along with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
* Strong understanding of full-stack application design, RESTful APIs, JSON, OpenAPI / Swagger, and API security
* Experience with SQL Server, database design, stored procedures, query optimization, and object-relational mapping
* Sound understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Moq, or equivalent tools
* Working experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
* Working experience with at least one cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure
* Experience troubleshooting production issues using application logs, telemetry, and monitoring tools
* Good understanding of secure coding, performance, scalability, accessibility, and responsive design
* Exposure to GenAI concepts and the integration of AI services or LLM-based capabilities into enterprise applications will be an added advantage
* Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt design, or AI-assisted development tools is desirable

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline

* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise web applications to production
* Hands-on experience across backend services, front-end development, databases, system integration, testing, and deployment
* Experience contributing to reusable frameworks, components, accelerators, or engineering standards
* Ability to independently own technical workstreams and collaborate effectively with distributed teams and stakeholders

**Ideally, you'll also have**
Hands-on experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, API Management, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, microservices, event-driven architecture, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines will be an added advantage. Microsoft Azure, .NET, cloud, DevOps, security, or AI certifications are preferred.
  
  
**What We Look For**

* Self-motivated individual with ownership of assigned workstreams and the ability to work independently
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate requirements into practical and sustainable technical solutions
* Clear communication with both technical and business stakeholders
* Commitment to engineering quality, continuous learning, collaboration, and mentoring
* Ability to balance delivery timelines with security, maintainability, user experience, and long-term product needs

description:
