title: IT Engineer,Software,Advanced
description:
****Overview****
**Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer**
****Overview****
 We're looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer — a technically sharp, hands\-on resource who will work alongside the team to optimize our Salesforce environment end to end. This isn't a cloud\-specific or module\-specific role. The focus is on platform health, code quality, scalable architecture, and engineering best practices across whatever clouds and features the org uses today or adopts tomorrow. Exposure to AI\-driven capabilities within the Salesforce ecosystem is a valuable bonus.
   

  

 We need someone who treats the Salesforce platform like a product — not a project. Someone who looks at a cluttered org and sees a roadmap, not a disaster. You’ll work hands\-on with the team to untangle, optimize, and future\-proof our Salesforce environment so it scales with the business.
   

  

 Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Platform Optimization \& Org Health**
* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.


**Development \& Code Quality**
* Build production\-grade Apex — bulkified, governor\-limit\-aware, single\-trigger\-per\-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source\-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.


**Integration \& Data Management**
* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.


**Collaboration \& Best Practices Enablement**
* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks\-vs\-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.


****Qualifications****
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Deep hands\-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6\+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.


**Good to have AI Exposure**
* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine\-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and API\-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of hands\-on Salesforce platform development — cloud\-agnostic, problem\-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.


 Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Forward Deployed Engineers
description:
**Summary**
 Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.
   

  

 This is not a order\-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI\-enabled solutions.
* Build and deploy agentic AI systems end\-to\-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
* Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
* In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
* In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production\-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
* In Products: configure and deploy pre\-built agentic products into client environments.
* Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
* Apply AI\-native engineering practices — agent\-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
* Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
* Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
* Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
* Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early\-stage discovery.


**KEY MEASURES**
* Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
* Production\-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
* Demonstrable productivity through AI\-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
* Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
* Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release


**Qualifications**
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 5\+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
* Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
* Full\-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
* Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
* Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
* Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
* Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.

*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*

**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**

* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges

* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

 Role title

 Programme context
   

  

 Deutsche Bank is progressing a strategic AI agenda focused on embedding trusted, scalable AI into business\-critical banking workflows. The DB Intelligence programme is understood to apply AI to decision intelligence, scenario analysis and risk\-aware insight generation, using external developments such as geopolitical, market, regulatory and macroeconomic events alongside internal portfolio and exposure data.
   

  

 The successful candidates will design, build and industrialise AI\-enabled applications that combine modern full stack engineering, data integration, AI/ML services and secure enterprise\-grade delivery. Strong hands\-on engineering depth across React, Python and Java is essential.
   

  

 Role purpose
   

  

 We are seeking senior, hands\-on AI engineering professionals who can translate complex business problems into production\-grade AI solutions. Candidates will work closely with product owners, data scientists, quants, risk specialists, architects, cyber/security, compliance and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, explainable, secure and observable solutions aligned to Deutsche Bank standards.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Design and build AI\-enabled applications for DB Intelligence, including user\-facing workflows, APIs, microservices, orchestration components and data integration layers.
* Develop modern React / TypeScript front ends with reusable components, strong API integration and user experiences that support explainable AI\-assisted workflows.
* Build Python services for AI/ML integration, model orchestration, RAG, agentic workflows, data processing, evaluation pipelines and automation.
* Develop and integrate Java / Spring Boot microservices for enterprise backend capabilities, business rules, workflow orchestration and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Work with structured and unstructured data sources, including internal systems, documents, market/event data, portfolio data and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Contribute to AI architectures using LLM APIs, prompt orchestration, embeddings, vector search, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop review.
* Engineer solutions that support scenario analysis, event\-driven intelligence, impact assessment, portfolio/risk insight generation and decision support.
* Apply strong engineering discipline: clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, performance tuning, resilience and production support readiness.
* Implement controls for data privacy, entitlement management, audit logging, explainability, traceability, model output monitoring and responsible AI usage.
* Provide senior technical contribution, design leadership, mentoring and reusable engineering patterns across the programme.


**Required Experience**
* Significant professional software engineering experience, including recent hands\-on delivery of AI, data, analytics or decision\-support platforms.
* Strong React and modern front\-end engineering experience, including TypeScript / JavaScript, state management, reusable component design and responsive UI development.
* Strong Python engineering experience, ideally including FastAPI / Flask, Pandas, data pipelines, AI/ML libraries, LLM integration, model evaluation or automation frameworks.
* Strong Java engineering experience, preferably with Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, resilience and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience building production\-grade applications with clear understanding of security, scalability, availability, latency, observability and maintainability.
* Practical GenAI / AI application experience, such as LLM APIs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, semantic search, agent workflows, hallucination mitigation and guardrails.
* Experience integrating enterprise data sources and APIs, including SQL databases, document stores, search platforms, messaging/event platforms or data lakes.
* Strong understanding of secure engineering, authentication/authorisation, entitlement models, data protection and audit requirements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and communicating complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


 Financial services / banking experience
   

  

 Financial services experience is highly valuable, particularly in investment banking, corporate banking, risk, markets, research, KYC, credit, portfolio analytics or regulatory technology. description:
Summary
 


 Andromeda Security is a top\-tier Silicon Valley VC\-funded multinational startup with a strong and experienced team. It is building an AI\-based identity and cloud security platform to help enterprise security teams protect their business from human and non\-human identity breaches. Its solutions are powered by real\-time risk and behavioral context, helping enterprises improve security decisions and reduce operational complexity. 
 




  






 We are experiencing rapid growth and are looking to expand our UI team in Bangalore, India.
 





 The main focus of this position is on design and implement user interfaces for a web application that visualizes complex identity security workflows.
 




  






 You will be bridging the gap between Figma mocks and backend APIs using REST and GraphQL clients. Techstack includes Vue, Vuetify as a component library, TypeScript as the primary language, and scoped SASS with a BEM naming scheme. Understanding of Google Protobuf is a plus.
 




  






 True to the startup culture, you will have many interactions with adjacent teams and iterate on the original design and business logic.
 




  






 What sets us apart from the typical startup approach is our focus on code quality, testing, modern tooling, CI pipeline, and the overall developer experience. We have a strong design team to ensure the user experience is smooth, coherent, and meets the high expectations of our customers.
 




  





 What we expect from you
 
* 4 \- 7 years of experience building single\-page apps with any modern JS framework.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
* Proficient in TypeScript and JavaScript fundamentals, including OOP concepts.
* Good understanding of pure CSS and semantic HTML, including CSS flex and grid layouts.
* A passion for building reliable, scalable, testable and maintainable components and utilities.
* Experience working in a high\-paced and mature team.
* The ability to solve UI\-specific engineering problems.
* Be self\-driven and proactive in understanding requirements and work with different teams to solve problems.
* Eager to learn and grow professionally with us.



  





 These will give you an edge
 
* Open\-source contributions or other notable personal projects.
* Experience of building UI infrastructure (abstract and highly reusable blocks) from scratch.
* Prior experience with GoLang, Protobuf, Server Side Rendering (Next/Nuxt) or end\-to\-end tests with Playwright or Puppeteer.
* Prior experience in cybersecurity or identity management domains, knowledge of secure frontend development practices, and prior work in B2B SaaS products.





 ﻿

* A no politics/nonsense high paced engineering culture.
* Environment fostering professional growth \- both in technology and area of responsibility.

* Great benefits package in addition to competitive cash and stock based compensation.

* Ship weekly: We move fast and ship often.

**Description**
 Prime Video is disrupting traditional media with an ever\-increasing selection of movies, TV shows, Emmy Award winning original content, add\-on subscriptions including HBO and Showtime, and live events like Thursday Night Football. Within this expanding ecosystem, Linear TV (24/7 Television or broadcast programming) has emerged as one of our fastest\-growing segments, with viewership hours increasing significantly year over year. This growth demonstrates that even in the streaming era, customers deeply value the lean\-back, curated experience that Linear TV provides.
   

  

 Our data shows that Linear TV viewers develop strong habitual viewing patterns, spending more time on the platform and engaging more consistently than traditional VOD\-only users. The key to supporting these viewing habits is providing seamless, personalized discovery experiences through robust and scalable services. The Linear Discovery Service (LDS) team owns the critical infrastructure that determines how Live TV content is presented to customers \- from the composition of the homepage experience to search capabilities that help customers find live programming. We decide what content collections and carousels appear on Linear pages, their ordering, and how search results are ranked and displayed across all Prime Video clients, ensuring millions of customers can easily find and enjoy their favorite live programming.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to take an active role in shaping how customers discover and interact with Live TV on Prime Video. We need your passion, innovative ideas, and creativity to help continue to deliver on our ambitious goals of creating intuitive, personalized, and responsive discovery experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer on the Linear Discovery Service team, you will:
   

  

* Design and implement the page composition engine that determines what carousels and content collections appear on Linear pages
* Build intelligent ordering systems that optimize the placement of content sections based on customer behavior and business rules
* Develop and maintain search services specifically optimized for Linear content, including live programs, channels, and upcoming shows
* Build and maintain scalable services that integrate with recommendation systems to provide personalized content listings
* Develop robust caching and content delivery mechanisms to ensure low\-latency responses for millions of concurrent users
* Collaborate with client teams to evolve page composition and search APIs based on new feature requirements
* Work with the Linear Personalization team to integrate recommendations into page composition and search ranking
* Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team's technical growth


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll work on services that directly shape how millions of customers discover and engage with Live TV content. Your day might involve analyzing the performance of a new carousel ordering algorithm, optimizing search relevance for an upcoming major linear event or designing a solution for real\-time program updates. You'll balance performance, scalability, and maintainability while ensuring our services meet the high standards our customers expect.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Linear Discovery Service team owns the end\-to\-end discovery experience for Live TV content across Prime Video. We determine what customers see when they land on Linear pages through our page composition engine, how they search for live content, and how content is presented to them. We work closely with Linear client teams and the Linear Personalization team to deliver personalized, responsive, and intuitive browsing experiences. Our services handle millions of requests per day, providing real\-time content information, search results, and page composition decisions to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Our mission is to make Live TV content discovery on Prime Video seamless and engaging, helping customers easily find the content they love while discovering new programs that match their interests. We're focused on building intelligent, scalable services that can grow with our rapidly expanding Linear TV audience while maintaining the high performance our customers expect.

title: Sr. Software Engineer (UI Developer)
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled Sr. Software Engineer to drive the high\-quality component delivery of the Ethos Design System (EDS).
   

  

 The UI Developer for EDS is a craftsman of the modern web platform. You are not building simple web pages; you are building the "Lego blocks" that the rest of the enterprise builds upon. You will specialize in Lit (Web Components) to create agnostic, future\-proof UI elements that function seamlessly in React, Angular, and Vue environments. Your code must be bulletproof, accessible, and performant, serving as the gold standard for thousands of developers across GE HealthCare.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About EDS**
 EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle," EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety.
   

  

**The Mission: Scale and Empowerment**
 We are in a phase of hyper\-growth, scaling from 15 adopting products to over 100\. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self\-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Component Engineering \& API Design
* Web Component Development: Develop robust, encapsulated UI components using the Lit library. You will write clean, semantic HTML and scoped CSS (SASS).
* Component API Architecture: You are responsible for writing clean, intuitive Component APIs. You define the Inputs (Props), Outputs (Events), and Slots that allow thousands of other developers to consume your code easily.
* Cross\-Framework Integration: You are responsible for the "Wrapper Layer." You will test and optimize your components to ensure they integrate seamlessly into React, Angular, and Vue applications.
* Design Fidelity \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Cross\-Functional Team: Work daily within a cross\-functional team comprising Architects, Product owners, LSD (Lead System Designers), DevOps, and QA. You ensure your components align with the broader architecture and CI/CD standards.
* Figma Proficiency: You will leverage Figma’s Dev Mode to inspect layers, extract properties, and ensure implementation matches the exact specifications of the design team.
* Accessibility Governance: You are a champion of inclusive design. You ensure every component complies with WCAG 2\.1 AA standards, including keyboard navigation, screen reader support (ARIA), and color contrast.
* Agile Execution \& Documentation
* Agile Rigor: Participate actively in Agile ceremonies. You are responsible for managing your work items in Rally, ensuring accurate status updates and story point estimation.
* Testing Rigor: You are responsible for writing comprehensive Unit Test Cases (using tools like ViTest or Jest).
* Technical Documentation: You treat documentation as part of the code. You contribute to Storybook, writing clear usage examples and technical integration guides.


**Core Competencies \& Soft Skills**
* Communicating Trade\-offs \& Alignment: Clearly explains technical options, trade\-offs, and risks for the features and components they own. Collaborates closely with peer engineers, UX, and product to align on approach and get to a shared decision.
* Technical Ownership: Acts as the go\-to owner for the design and implementation of the components/features they build within the UI and Design System platform. Takes full accountability for their work from design through delivery and maintenance and contributes actively to broader architectural discussions.
* Applied AI for Development: Uses AI\-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review as part of daily workflow. Understands model selection and context/token management and follows team\-level AI development practices (validation, security, human\-review controls) to consistently improve their own productivity.
* Evidence\-Based Direction: Raises concerns and proposes improvements to existing approaches when justified, backing suggestions with data or concrete examples rather than opinion alone.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in front\-end development.
+ Mandatory: Proven experience building Enterprise Software applications.

* UX Collaboration: Mandatory: 3\+ years of experience working closely with UX Designers. You must demonstrate proficiency using Figma's Dev Mode.
* Technical Stack:
+ Mandatory: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
+ Mandatory: Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and SASS architecture.
+ Mandatory: Proficiency using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, GH Copilot, Claude) as part of your daily coding workflow, from writing and reviewing code to debugging and documentation.
+ Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Lit or native Web Components.

* Agile \& Process:
+ Mandatory: Proficiency working in Agile environments and using Rally.
+ Experience writing Unit Tests (Jest, ViTest) and documentation (Storybook).


**Inclusion And Diversity**
 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
   

  

 Our
 **total rewards** 
 are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 Behind that infrastructure is a product that has to make complex financial systems feel simple. That is the part you would own.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build the interfaces thousands of businesses use to get paid: dashboard, checkout, onboarding, billing, and analytics. This is not a role that converts Figma screens into React. You will look at a flow, question it, improve it, and ship the better version. The surfaces are genuinely hard: a subscription half\-upgraded mid\-cycle, a payout held for review, a usage meter that has to be legible to a founder at 2am.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Ownership: Own features from problem to production. Understand the problem, prototype the experience, build it, talk to the API, handle the weird states, ship it, then watch how people use it and make it better.
* Core Surfaces: Build and improve the merchant dashboard, checkout, onboarding, subscriptions and usage billing, customer management, revenue analytics, and payment and payout flows.
* Interface Craft: Own the last 10% of UI quality. Loading, error, and empty states are part of the product, not cleanup afterwards.
* 0 to 1 Product: Take new products from a rough idea to something customers use, often before there is a full spec or design.
* Systems and Reuse: Build primitives and shared components where they pay off, and know when to just ship the thing instead.
* Collaboration: Work directly with product, design, backend engineers, and founders. There is no long chain of PM to designer to frontend to QA handoffs.
* Developer Experience: Contribute to the surfaces developers touch, including docs, API keys, test mode, and our SDKs.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years building production web applications, with strong React and TypeScript.
* Shipping Record: You have shipped real products used by real customers, not projects that ended at localhost.
* UI Quality: Demonstrable care for craft. You notice the modal that is 30px too wide and the form that technically works but feels exhausting.
* Product Judgment: You can build from a rough idea without waiting for a 20\-page spec, and you push back when something is not good enough.
* AI Fluency: You use AI heavily and still know what good code looks like. We care more about what you caught the model getting wrong than how fast you generated the first draft.
* Domain Curiosity: You do not need to arrive knowing what a chargeback flow looks like. You do need to want to understand the payments system behind the UI you are building.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.
* Bonus: Developer tools, fintech, dashboards, or complex B2B products.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, with significant influence over the product, the interface, and the company's direction.
* Ownership: Within weeks you will have shipped something customers use. Within months there are meaningful parts of Dodo you completely own. Eventually you are in the room before there is even a design.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.

**Senior Engineer Software \- Front End** 




 GCC Bangalore \| Supply Chain Order Management, Wholesale \& Transportation
 



  





**Company Overview:** 




 Albertsons\-Safeway Company is one of the largest food and drug retailers with 2,300\+ stores. The Albertsons\-Safeway family of brands includes prominent brands in food retailing, supported by teams across the U.S. and global capability centers.
 



  





**Position Purpose:** 




 Albertsons Companies' Supply Chain team is hiring a Senior Engineer Software \- Front End for the GCC Bangalore team. This individual contributor role will be hands\-on and will partner with engineering, design, product, architecture, business stakeholders, and distributed technology teams to deliver web and mobile capabilities for Order Management, Wholesale, and Transportation business functions.
 



 The ideal candidate is a front\-end leaning full\-stack engineer who can build production\-quality React/TypeScript user experiences, contribute to Java/Spring Boot APIs and integrations, and use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity without compromising security, quality, or maintainability.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 



* Modernize user experiences for supply chain applications such as order visibility, wholesale workflows, transportation execution, and mobile\-enabled operations.
* Reduce dependency on highly specialized legacy resources by standardizing modern web, API, mobile, and integration patterns.
* Partner with U.S. and India teams to build scalable, observable, maintainable solutions that can support high\-volume supply chain operations.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Front\-end engineering:** 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, and modern component\-driven UI patterns.
* **Mobile enablement:** 
 Build or support mobile\-friendly workflows and, where needed, contribute to React Native, Flutter, or native Android/iOS implementations.
* **Full\-stack collaboration:** 
 Partner with backend engineers to integrate UI capabilities with REST APIs, Java/Spring Boot services, Kafka/event\-driven workflows, and enterprise data sources.
* **Domain delivery:** 
 Translate Supply Chain Order Management, Wholesale, and Transportation requirements into intuitive user journeys, reusable components, and reliable production features.
* **Quality ownership:** 
 Own unit, integration, end\-to\-end, accessibility, regression, and mobile testing expectations using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent.
* **Performance and reliability:** 
 Tune front\-end performance, address browser/mobile compatibility issues, contribute to observability, and troubleshoot production issues across UI, API, and integration layers.
* **Engineering standards:** 
 Write clean, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; contribute to design reviews; and model secure development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* **AI\-assisted development:** 
 Use GitHub Copilot or similar tools for productivity, test scaffolding, refactoring, and documentation while validating generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* **Team collaboration:** 
 Work effectively with peer engineers, architects, product owners, QA, SRE/DevOps, and business stakeholders across geographies.
* **Mentoring:** 
 Guide less experienced engineers on coding standards, quality practices, debugging, and front\-end architecture patterns.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 5\-7 years of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on web application development.
* Strong experience with ReactJS or AngularJS; React with TypeScript is highly preferred for this front\-end role.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, responsive design, browser fundamentals, and accessibility\-aware UI development.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and collaborating with Java/Spring Boot microservices teams.
* Experience with SQL and data modeling concepts; familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle, Azure SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
* Practical knowledge of test automation for web applications, including unit and end\-to\-end testing frameworks.
* Experience with Git, code review practices, and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
* Cloud exposure on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including deployment and operational support considerations.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across UI, API, data, and integration touchpoints.
* Ability to understand stakeholder expectations, clarify requirements, and escalate delivery risks early.



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications:** 



* Mobile application experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin/Android, Swift/iOS, Android Jetpack/Compose, Appium, or Espresso.
* Exposure to Kafka, event streaming, asynchronous integration patterns, API contracts, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
* Java/Spring Boot hands\-on experience sufficient to contribute to API scaffolding, debugging, integration testing, and service\-level improvements.
* NoSQL experience such as MongoDB or Cassandra, plus mobile data synchronization or offline\-first design exposure.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, observability tools, performance tuning, and production support practices.
* Supply chain, logistics, wholesale, order management, transportation, yard management, or retail technology domain experience.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot with a validation\-first engineering mindset.
* Exposure to GraphQL, design systems, micro frontends, component libraries, or modern front\-end build tooling.
* Experience with delivery of applications to users

If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Lead UI Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a highly experienced
 **Lead UI Engineer** 
 with 12–15 years of software development experience and strong expertise in building scalable, high\-performance, and responsive web applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have deep hands\-on experience with
 **Angular, React, TypeScript, eCharts, frontend integration, and responsive UI development** 
 . The candidate will be responsible for defining frontend architecture, developing complex user interfaces, integrating frontend applications with backend services, and providing technical leadership to development teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance frontend applications using Angular and React.
* Define and drive the frontend architecture, design patterns, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Develop reusable UI components, shared libraries, and frontend frameworks to improve development efficiency and consistency.
* Build rich, interactive, and data\-driven visualizations using eCharts.
* Develop dashboards, charts, graphs, and other visualization components for complex datasets.
* Design and implement responsive user interfaces supporting multiple screen resolutions, browsers, and devices.
* Develop applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, Web APIs, WebSockets, or other integration mechanisms.
* Collaborate closely with backend developers, UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders.
* Optimize frontend applications for performance, scalability, maintainability, and usability.
* Identify and resolve complex UI, browser compatibility, integration, and performance issues.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and secure coding practices.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to frontend developers.
* Evaluate new frontend technologies, frameworks, and libraries and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning.
* Drive improvements in frontend development practices, automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment processes.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 12–15 years of overall software development experience, with significant experience in frontend application development.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Angular and its ecosystem.
* Strong hands\-on experience with React and component\-based application development.
* Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with eCharts or similar data visualization/charting frameworks.
* Experience developing complex data visualization dashboards and interactive charts.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS/SASS, Flexbox, and CSS Grid.
* Strong experience in responsive and adaptive UI development.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture and modern design patterns.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, API error handling, state management, and frontend data flow.
* Experience with frontend performance optimization, lazy loading, caching, and bundle optimization.
* Familiarity with unit testing and frontend testing frameworks.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to translate business and user requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross\-functional teams.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
* Passion for building intuitive, performant, and high\-quality user experiences.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline** 
 .
